messages:
alerts-bot: [ALERT] Instance rwinf-kg-19: KV_CACHE_OOM spike x3 in 6m. PID=2245 killed by oom_killer. Contexts active: some > 250k tokens.
jenn (oncall): seeing increased 5xx and slow tail latencies. paging counts high. grabbing logs now. @maria @oliver please triage. :eyes:
maria (eng-runtime): on it. attaching first-pass tail logs. looks like repeated pagewalk stalls then fast re-alloc attempts. reuse-window metric collapsed.
maria (eng-runtime): snippet:
```
2026-03-18T10:04:12Z kvpager: pagewalk 324ms (8x) host=rwinf-kg-19 shard=3
2026-03-18T10:04:13Z kvalloc: alloc retry loop 5 -> fallback slab (grow)
2026-03-18T10:04:13Z kvfrag: fragmentation=0.67 reuse_hit=0.12
```
oliver (eng-runtime): that frag number is new for this pool. any recent changes to kernel-selection or alloc windows rolled out?
sam (eng-runtime): we did a batching & kernel heuristics tweak yesterday to favor quant-kernel for medium seq. unlikely to touch KV but the change also bumped max-page-prefetch on that fleet. could be correlated.
maria (eng-runtime): hypothesis: prefetch increase + longer contexts -> pagewalker thrash causing fragmented small free slots and failing fast reuse, then allocs escalate and OOM.
jenn (oncall): mitigation options? Can we soft-degrade quickly to avoid customer impact?
maria (eng-runtime): immediate: 1) toggle kv_prefetch=0 on rwinf fleet (fast config flip) 2) enable kv_soft_evict (reject large prefixes >128k tokens) 3) route long-context traffic to longctx-limited model variant. All are reversible.
sam (eng-runtime): I can flip kv_prefetch in the runtime config via /infra/flags. command: `curl -XPOST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://ops-api/flags?r=rwinf&kv_prefetch=0`
jen (typo) jenn (oncall): go ahead with flips, coordinate with deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: Starting flag rollout: kv_prefetch=0 -> target=rwinf-kg-*. 120s stagger.
maria (eng-runtime): also starting a small hotfix to reduce reuse-window's aggressiveness (reduce reuse_retire_ms from 1200 -> 600) and add additional telemetry to count pagewalk backoffs. will open PR and patch.
oliver (eng-runtime): for repro: please capture a perf trace around pagewalker path. use `perf record -F 99 -p 2245 -g -- sleep 30` and also enable kv_debug=trace for one host.
sam (eng-runtime): temporary rate-limiting for requests with context_length > 200k: add middleware rule in API gateway. I can push a rule that responds 429 for new requests (not backlog ones) to avoid filling cache.
deploy-bot: Flag rollout complete: kv_prefetch=0 -> 6/6 hosts updated.
jenn (oncall): latency dropping in 2m window, 5xx down from 4.7% -> 0.8%. good sign.
maria (eng-runtime): next actions: PR for reuse_retire tweak (owner: maria), long-term: better compaction + opt reclaim path (oliver), add KV eviction circuit breaker in runtime (sam). I'll attach repro artifacts to the incident.
oliver (eng-runtime): agree. add an alert for reuse_hit < 0.2 + pagewalk_rate>100/min so we catch earlier.
jenn (oncall): thanks team. logging incident, will escalate to postmortem if we see recurrence within 72h. :thumbsup:
